slide1.title: Executive Business Review Q2 2026
slide1.subtitle: Performance overview, regional results, and operational risk assessment
slide1.summary: NovaRetail delivered total revenue of $1.28B with +4.5% QoQ growth in 2026-Q2. APAC leads regional growth at +8.2%, while Latin America remains the primary operational concern with declining revenue and severe logistics constraints.

slide2.title: Regional Revenue Growth and Performance Divergence
insights: APAC leads regional growth at 8.2% with 330M revenue.
North America is the largest contributor with 465M revenue.
Europe achieved 4.5% growth generating 345M in revenue.
Latin America declined by 6.7% with 140M revenue.

slide3.title: Customer Experience Varies Widely Across Regions
insights: APAC leads customer experience with an NPS of 62 and 92% CSAT.
North America maintains solid metrics with an NPS of 55 and 89% CSAT.
Europe reports stable customer satisfaction with an NPS of 53 and 88% CSAT.
Latin America lags severely with an NPS of 29 and 74% CSAT.

slide4.title: Operational Risks Concentrated in Latin America
insights: Latin America exhibits a 12.5% stockout rate and 10 return processing days.
Latin America recorded 30 fraud incidents, significantly above other regions.
APAC shows high warehouse capacity utilization at 92% with 8.5% stockouts.
North America and Europe maintain stable warehouse and fulfillment metrics.

slide5.title: Recommended Actions & Next Steps
recommendations: Investigate fulfillment bottlenecks in Latin America to address delivery delays.
Enhance fraud prevention controls across Latin American logistics operations.
Optimize inventory management in APAC to relieve high warehouse utilization.
Scale successful customer experience strategies from APAC to underperforming regions.
slide5.closing: Prioritize operational stabilization in Latin America while scaling APAC growth momentum.
